name: Thermador Groupe SA
summary: Thermador Groupe SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the distribution business in France and internationally. The company offers central heating and domestic hot water accessories, pumps for heating, plumbing equipment, taps, valves for building, ventilation equipment and accessories, industrial valves and fittings, cold water pumps, swimming pool equipment and accessories, air compressors, generators, and welding stations. It also provides pneumatic tools; pumps, household valves, and plumbing for DIY superstores; bathroom and kitchen taps for DIY superstores and retail outlets; sale of parts to boiler manufacturers; domestic pumps and pump accessories; accessories and connectors…
